description: Controller record of the code-change input: the target repository, the default branch tip the worktree was created from, the worktree path and the design doc; the exact design doc bytes are the evidence file design-doc

repository.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, exactly as given in the prompt

default_branch.description: The repository's default branch when the worktree was created

base_sha.description: The default branch tip fetched when the worktree was created; the worktree starts detached at this commit

worktree.description: Absolute path of the Controller-owned worktree

path.description: The design doc path exactly as given in the prompt

resolved.description: The literal cleaned absolute path that was read: path itself when absolute, otherwise path joined to the launch directory; symlinks are not resolved
